name: CFPB complaints about debt collection, credit reporting and debt management, by state and month
description: Complaints that consumers filed with the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) about debt collection, credit reporting and credit repair, and debt or credit management, counted by state, month, product and issue from January 2018, with the last 12 months set against the 12 before and per 100,000 residents. One record per state, DC, Puerto Rico and territory for each of the three product groups, with the share of complaints the company answered on time and the issue people raised most. The counts come from the CFPB's own Consumer Complaint Database search API, as aggregates, so no complaint, narrative, company name or ZIP code is ever copied; for every month the issue counts add up to the bureau's own count for each product group. The bureau changed its credit-reporting product name twice; every name is combined into one group. Complaints are consumers' own reports, not findings of any violation.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). CFPB complaints about debt collection, credit reporting and debt management, by state and month (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963181

distribution.name: consumer-complaints.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: consumer-complaints.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: consumer-complaints-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in consumer-complaints-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to consumer-complaints.csv on id.

recordSet.name: consumer-complaints
recordSet.description: The records of CFPB complaints about debt collection, credit reporting and debt management, by state and month, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: measure
field.description: debt-collection, credit-reporting (credit reporting and credit repair, all product names the CFPB has used since 2018) or debt-management (debt or credit management)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: value
field.description: Complaints received in the last 12 complete months

field.name: previous12
field.description: Complaints received in the 12 months before that

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
